verdict.rationale: Drata's Public APIv2 documents broad create, update and delete coverage across core UI domains: controls, policies and versions, evidence library, custom frameworks, monitoring tests, custom connections, devices, and a full set of risk resources. Trust center and questionnaire automation are also claimed. However, Drata makes no explicit UI–API parity claim, some areas appear read-only (Audits list/get, Personnel list/search), and the device endpoint is marked experimental. Missing for 10: an explicit parity commitment, documented write coverage for audits, personnel and other UI workflows, and independent or hands-on confirmation that UI actions are fully reproducible via the API.
